comment: Models only the Windows app downloads, in the same shape as module-one/models/artifact-pins.json (ModelManifest reads both). The Mac runs Vedu Scribe through MLX from artifact-pins.json, so this GGUF entry stays Windows-only.

clouddevaakash/vedu-scribe-0.8b-gguf.comment: Vedu Scribe 0.8B (heyvedu/vedu-scribe-0.8b@7dced58) converted to GGUF Q8_0 by module-one/cleanup/convert_gguf.py (mlx-lm 0.32.2, llama.cpp c7fc509, 24-layer header). Uploaded 2026-11-19 to clouddevaakash/vedu-scribe-0.8b-gguf; size and SHA-256 checked against the Hugging Face API.

csukuangfj/sherpa-onnx-pyannote-segmenta.comment: pyannote segmentation-3.0 exported to ONNX by sherpa-onnx (csukuangfj). Speaker separation, segmentation half. Hash and size checked against the Hugging Face API and a local download on 2026-11-19.

csukuangfj/speaker-embedding-models.comment: WeSpeaker VoxCeleb ResNet34 speaker embedding (wespeaker_en_voxceleb_resnet34.onnx) from the sherpa-onnx speaker-embedding collection; Wespeaker/wespeaker-voxceleb-resnet34 declares Apache-2.0. Speaker separation, embedding half. Only this file is pinned.

ggml-org/gemma-3-4b-it-GGUF.comment: Gemma 3 4B instruction-tuned, Q4_K_M GGUF, the Windows default local meeting-notes model (windows/bench/notes/NOTES_MODEL_BENCHMARK.md). Revision, size and LFS SHA-256 read from the Hugging Face API on 2026-11-21; the SHA-256 and size were recomputed on the copy the benchmark ran (bench-notes/models/gemma3-4b) and match. Licence: Gemma Terms of Use (card tag `gemma`), not an OSI licence; the download confirmation shows the terms notice and the Prohibited Use Policy link.
